senses.gloss: הִמְדִּיר (denom. of מַדְרוֹן) to slant, to incline.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 22b:7">B. Bath. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>במַמְדִּיר את וכ׳</he> Ar. a. Ms. F. (Ms. M. <he>בממרי׳</he>; ed. <he>במדיר</he>. Ms. H. <he>במְרַדֵּד</he>; Ms. O. <he>בממרדיר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) when he inclines the sill of his wall (so that none can stand or lean on it).
